summary: Iteration 3 end-to-end testing: JWT admin auth, protected /api/projects mutations, Claude Sonnet 4.6 chatbot (basic + multi-turn context), 3-way theme, real portfolio, Website tier Popular, Portfolio nav+footer links, admin login flow. Backend pytest 14/14 pass; frontend Playwright: all critical selectors and integration flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports resend/jwt/bcrypt/emergentintegrations at module top — good; startup event correctly re-seeds admin when password changes (matches playbook idempotent seed).
require_admin returns 401 for missing bearer and 403 if role mismatch — currently seeded role is 'admin' so this is fine; consider unifying to 401 for consistency.
/api/chat has no auth or rate limiting — public visitors can consume LLM budget freely. Add IP-based rate limiting or per-session throttling before public launch.
Chat replies persisted to db.chat_messages without a TTL index — will grow indefinitely.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is browser-invalid — since JWT is used via Authorization header (not cookies), this is functionally OK but should be tightened to explicit origins for production.
seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned up TEST_UI_Proj_* test projects. Also removed 2 leftover test projects from previous iterations ('Auth Test', 'Test') via admin DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers: health, auth (login success/fail, /auth/me with/without/bad token), projects (public GET, unauth POST/DELETE=401, admin create+list+delete+404), chat (basic NL + multi-turn context with session_id continuity), contact regression. Must run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set (from frontend/.env). Frontend verified: nav-portfolio→/portfolio present; 3-way theme (light/dark/system) toggles html.dark and persists to localStorage 'pb_theme_mode'; pricing-card-web has 'Popular' badge and pricing-card-ict does NOT; footer-link-projects (emoji-free) + footer-link-portfolio present; /portfolio (page-projects) shows all 6 seeded case studies (Boekweit Logistics, Groninger Zorgcoöperatie, Bakkerij De Peer, AiVoice Studio, Fresh Studio, Peer Advies); when NOT admin projects-admin-login-link visible instead of projects-add-button; admin login at /admin/login stores token in localStorage 'pb_admin_token' and redirects to /projecten; after admin login projects-add-button appears, project-form (project-input-title/image/category, project-form-submit) creates a project persisted to backend; chatbot-launcher opens chatbot-panel, sending 'Wat kost een website?' returns a Claude Sonnet 4.6 reply mentioning pricing/website within ~15s.
